review_candidates.title: Health Information Officer
review_candidates.description: TITLE: Health Information Officer TEAM/PROGRAMME: Health Team LOCATION: Cairo, Maadi GRADE : 4 (Competitive package) CONTRACT LENGTH: Pending Doner Approval Child Safeguarding Level 3: the post holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work country programs; or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the police checking/vetting process staff. Role Purpose Health information officer will lead on all the health information system of the health program medical data will play the key role in monitoring all project activities, evaluation of health outcomes, and implementation progress and work plan, and achieving project objectives. S/he will support the decision making by providing the data analysis results to the program manager, timely reporting on all project activities, including elective and emergency services. In addition, S/he will participate in monitoring and assessing the quality of health care services provided when needed. In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder, will be expected to work outside the normal role profile and be able to vary working hours accordingly. Scope Of Role Reports to: direct Program Manager and indirect to the MEAL Staff reporting to this post: NA Key Areas Of Accountability Project Implementation Design and create reporting format, line list and database and dashboards for all health project data and information, including primary and secondary medical referrals cases, and other project activities, that fulfil the donor requirements in Monitoring and evaluation plan. Collect, verify and enter and analyze the data that includes but is not limited to; health outcomes, medical interventions, cost/benefit analysis, prepare the monthly, quarterly, and annual reports as required All project data, information, databases, and reports should be saved and documented in the formal SCI SharePoint and cited as references Assist the health team by correcting data errors and guiding them to provide and submit accurate data and reports. Support with MEAL team on program specific learning processes, including documenting lessons learnt, organizing lessons learnt workshops etc. Ensure regular use, reporting and action tracking on the project's quality benchmarks Collaborate and contribute with MEAL team, project team and Accountability team to ensure a strong, accessible and inclusive feedback and reporting mechanism is available for beneficiaries. Participate in provider assessment when required. Respond to deviation and prepare the deviation report and participate in the investigation as assigned by the project manager. Conduct audit visits to project to assure compliance with project guidance and SOPs Holding regular meetings to present health analysis and enhance team awareness of the health information system and its role in decision-making. Perform any tasks assigned by the line manager as necessary. Reporting and documentation Collect, verify and analyze the project data, and MOVs prepare the monthly, quarterly, and annual reports and other reports as required. Prepare and submit the deviation report, including the cause/justification, incident evaluation, and corrective and preventive actions. Submit the reports on time to the Project Manager Ensure regular and timely reporting on the project IPTT (indicator performance tracking tool). Ensure regular and timely analysis reporting on indicators for donor reporting. Budgeting Support in quality budget phasing, monitoring and utilization, participates in cost/benefit assessment for admitted/hospitalized cases, guided by establish health referral SOP, considering the health outcomes BEHAVIOURS (Values In Practice) Accountability Holds self-accountable for making decisions, managing resources efficiently, achieving and role modelling Save the Children values Holds the team and partners accountable to deliver on their responsibilities - giving them the freedom to deliver in the best way they see fit, providing the necessary development to improve performance and applying appropriate consequences when results are not achieved. Ambition Sets ambitious and challenging goals for themselves and their team, takes responsibility for their own personal development and encourages their team to do the same Widely shares their personal vision for Save the Children, engages and motivates others Future orientated, thinks strategically and on a global scale. Collaboration Builds and maintain effective relationships with their team, colleagues, Members and external partners and supporters Values diversity, sees it as a source of competitive strength Approachable, good listener, easy to talk to. Creativity Develops and encourages new and innovative solutions Willing to take disciplined risks. Integrity Honest, encourages openness and transparency; demonstrates highest levels of integrity Qualifications Bachelor’s degree of health-related field. Medical and paramedical background is preferred Post graduate certificate or degree in public health / statistics, is preferred. Experience And Skills Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in Health Information Systems, data management, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field, preferably with a UN agency or INGO. Previous experience working with health projects, humanitarian programmes, or vulnerable groups responses are highly desirable. Proven experience in data collection, data management, validation, analysis, and reporting, with strong attention to data quality and accuracy. Proven experience using statistical and data analysis software and digital data management platforms. Strong ability to develop and maintain data tracking tools, dashboards, databases, and routine programme reports. Good understanding of health indicators, data quality assurance, and reporting requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated results-oriented approach. Excellent computer skills, particularly in Microsoft Excel and other data management and analysis tools. Strong interpersonal, communication, coordination, and teamwork skills. Strong government relations, networking, and stakeholder coordination skills. Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of Child Safeguarding principles and humanitarian standards is an advantage. Commitment to Save the Children International's values, vision, mission, and safeguarding principles. Additional Job Responsibilities The duties and responsibilities as set out above are not exhaustive and the role holder may be required to carry out additional duties within reasonableness of their level of skills and experience. Equal Opportunities The role holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the SCI Equal Opportunities and Diversity policies and procedures. Child Safeguarding We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse. Health and Safety The role holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with SCI Health and Safety policies and procedures. Updated By: Omar El. Noman Date: August 2026 Reviewed and signoff By: Qais Jassar Date: August 2026 Job Identification 17460 Job Category Programme Operations Posting Date 08/25/2026, 10:24 AM Apply Before 09/08/2026, 08:59 PM Job Schedule Full time Locations CO - Cairo

review_candidates.title: Head of Transformation and Change BEI
review_candidates.description: Job Description Head of Transformation and Change BEI Egypt Full time How You’ll Help Us Make Health Happen We are seeking an established Transformation & Change professional to lead the delivery of a major business transformation programme within Bupa Egypt Insurance. This role will initially lead the implementation of a new domestic PMI business in Egypt, including the establishment of a local TPA, development of a target operating model, and deployment of supporting technology platforms. The programme will involve significant business and technology change, delivered in partnership with local, regional and global teams. The successful candidate will oversee a portfolio of strategic change initiatives, ensuring delivery of business outcomes, benefits realisation, effective governance, and alignment with business strategy. Programme Leadership & Delivery Lead large, complex transformation programmes from mobilisation through to implementation. Develop and maintain programme roadmaps, delivery plans and dependencies across multiple workstreams. Drive business, operational, technology and organisational change to achieve targeted outcomes. Ensure business readiness, implementation planning and successful transition into operational support. Apply delivery best practices to improve programme performance and responsiveness. Stakeholder & Governance Management Build strong relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Establish and lead governance forums, steering committees and decision-making structures. Provide clear reporting on programme progress, risks, issues, dependencies and outcomes. Influence senior leaders to secure alignment, resources and timely decisions. Financial & Commercial Management Support development and management of programme business cases. Own programme forecasts, budgets and financial performance. Identify and manage delivery and financial risks, implementing corrective actions where required. Ensure programme costs and benefits are appropriately governed and approved. Vendor & Third-Party Management Manage relationships with implementation partners, suppliers and third-party vendors. Define and oversee delivery against agreed statements of work and contractual commitments. Challenge performance and proactively manage risks to ensure successful delivery outcomes. Leadership & Continuous Improvement Lead matrix teams across multiple functions, geographies and disciplines. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Drive effective risk management, problem solving and decision making across the programme. Champion agile ways of working and delivery excellence. About You You will be a proven transformation leader with experience delivering large-scale business and technology change programmes in complex, matrix organisations. Key Skills / Qualifications Needed For This Role Extensive experience leading large, complex transformation programmes. Strong programme, portfolio and governance management expertise. Significant experience overseeing major technology-enabled change. Commercially astute with experience managing substantial budgets and business cases. Strong stakeholder management and executive influencing skills. Experience managing third-party suppliers and delivery partners. Experience working across geographically dispersed teams and matrix structures. Desirable Experience Health insurance or broader insurance and financial services experience. Experience of greenfield implementations, new business launches or operating model transformation. Key Attributes Strategic thinker with strong execution capability. Highly accountable and outcome focused. Confident decision-maker who thrives in complex environments. Strong leadership, communication and influencing skills. Resilient, collaborative and able to build high-performing teams. Passionate about transformation, continuous improvement and delivering customer value. Why Bupa? Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad. Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with Sukoon), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador. Time Type Full time Job Area Strategy, Change & Transformation Locations: Egypt - Cairo

review_candidates.title: Growth Marketing Manager
review_candidates.job_function: Marketing, Product Management, and Business Development
review_candidates.description: ⚠️ Please read carefully before applying. We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager with strong hands-on experience in B2C mobile app growth, user acquisition, retention, and subscription monetization. This is not a traditional digital marketing role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate measurable mobile app growth results — including the apps they worked on, the numbers before and after, and the actions they personally took to achieve those results. 📌 Position: Growth Marketing Manager 🌍 Location: 100% Remote , Based in Egypt 💼 Job Type: Full‑time 📄 Contract Type: Long-term project-based role with ongoing extension based on project continuity and performance 💰 Salary: Competitive USD Salary – Get paid in USD. 🗣 Language: Excellent English communication skills are mandatory for this client-facing role. 🕘 Working Hours: Aligned with the USA time zone 🚀 Start Date: Immediate 📅 Working Days : Monday to Friday 🔵 About the Role You will take ownership of the full growth funnel for a consumer mobile application — from user acquisition and activation to engagement, retention, and monetization. The role is focused on significantly scaling the active user base while building and optimizing a sustainable monetization engine that converts free users into monthly and annual paying subscribers. This is a highly hands-on, outcomes-driven role for someone who has previously delivered measurable growth for B2C mobile applications. 🔵 Key Responsibilities Own and execute the full B2C mobile app growth strategy across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization. Develop a clear channel-by-channel strategy to significantly grow the app's active user base. Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid user acquisition campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google App Campaigns, Apple Search Ads, and other relevant channels . Manage acquisition performance against key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, and payback period . Lead App Store Optimization (ASO) across keywords, app-store listings, creatives, ratings, reviews, and localization. Design and optimize the freemium-to-paid subscription funnel , including monthly and annual subscription plans. Work closely with Product to determine which features remain free and which should sit behind the paywall based on user behavior, data, competitive benchmarking, and willingness-to-pay signals. Own and test subscription pricing, packages, tiers, offers, and regional pricing strategies . Design and run structured A/B tests across onboarding, activation flows, paywalls, pricing, messaging, and subscription offers. Analyze and improve activation, engagement, and retention throughout the customer lifecycle. Build and maintain growth dashboards covering MAU, DAU, activation, retention, free-to-paid conversion, ARPU, LTV, CAC, and ROAS . Own lifecycle and re-engagement initiatives across push notifications, email, and in-app messaging . Stay current with mobile attribution, privacy, and platform developments including ATT, SKAdNetwork/SKAN, and related mobile measurement changes . Regularly report growth performance, experiments, insights, and recommendations to leadership. 🔵 Required Qualifications Strong hands-on experience in B2C mobile app growth . Proven experience scaling consumer mobile applications with measurable results. Ability to demonstrate previous growth achievements using clear before-and-after metrics . Strong experience with paid mobile user acquisition . Hands-on experience with channels such as Meta, TikTok, Google App Campaigns, and Apple Search Ads . Strong understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis, and mobile growth economics . Experience with freemium and/or subscription-based mobile products . Proven experience improving free-to-paid and/or trial-to-paid conversion . Experience working on paywalls, subscription pricing, packaging, or monetization experiments . Strong understanding of mobile app activation, engagement, and retention . Experience designing and running structured growth and product experiments . Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make decisions based on data. Experience with mobile analytics, attribution, and subscription platforms such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, RevenueCat, or similar tools is highly valuable. 🔵Nice to Have Experience growing mobile applications within wellness, health, fitness, mindfulness, lifestyle, consumer subscription, or other high-engagement B2C categories . 🔵Why Join Fekra? 🏆 ISO-Certified & ISTQB Platinum Partner – Be part of a globally recognized company. 🌍 100% Remote – Work from anywhere! 💰 Competitive Salary 🚀 Exciting Projects – Work on cutting-edge fintech and cloud-based applications. 📈 Career Growth – Enjoy continuous learning and professional development. 💡 Flexible Work Options – Part-time and full-time remote opportunities. 🤝 Collaborative Culture – Join a dynamic, supportive, and innovative team.

review_candidates.title: Business Analyst
review_candidates.description: We are hiring a Business Analyst for an established Egyptian agribusiness group. The group delivers integrated agricultural solutions across the value chain, with operations spanning modern farming, greenhouse and irrigation solutions, agricultural inputs, post-harvest handling, and technical services. It supports commercial farms and agricultural projects through practical field expertise and technology-driven solutions that enhance productivity, quality, and resource efficiency. 📍 Location: El Obour Industrial Zone, Cairo Key Responsibilities: Analyse business performance across departments and identify improvement opportunities. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools. Translate data into actionable business insights and conduct root cause analysis. Review and optimize business processes, workflows, and operational efficiency. Support automation and digital transformation initiatives. Assist with business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and feasibility studies. Conduct market and industry research, preferably within the agriculture sector. Collaborate with stakeholders, gather business requirements, and present recommendations to management. Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and governance standards. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field. 3 to 5 years of experience in Business Analysis or a similar role. Experience in agriculture, agribusiness, or supply chain industries is preferred. Advanced proficiency in Excel, BI tools, and ERP systems (SAP is a plus). Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of business processes and financial metrics.

review_candidates.title: Custom Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : Microsoft 365 SharePoint Online Development Good to have skills : NA Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Custom Software Engineer, SharePoint Developer will play a key role in architecting and delivering digital workspace solutions using SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analysing business requirements, designing scalable solutions, and implementing advanced workflows, integrations, and customisations. The position requires close collaboration with stakeholders, business analysts, and IT professionals to deliver projects that enhance user experience, automate processes, and support ongoing digital transformation. Roles & Responsibilities: Solution Design & Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of advanced SharePoint Online solutions, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability. Develop documentation and technical specifications for new features and enhancements. Development & Customisation: Build and customise SharePoint sites, document libraries, lists, pages, and web parts. Utilise SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), and custom scripting to deliver bespoke functionality tailored to business requirements. Integration: Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 services, line-of-business applications, and third-party platforms using APIs, Azure functions, and connectors. Migration: Lead or support large-scale migrations from legacy SharePoint environments and on-premises solutions to SharePoint Online. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with the Digital Workspace Lead, business stakeholders, and end users to gather requirements, present solution prototypes, and deliver training and support. Governance & Security: Implement and maintain best practices for SharePoint governance, security, compliance, and information architecture. Troubleshooting & Support: Provide advanced troubleshooting and support for SharePoint-related issues, collaborating with IT support teams as necessary. Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with the latest SharePoint and Microsoft 365 developments. Recommend and implement enhancements to improve usability, performance, and security. Professional & Technical Skills: Proven SharePoint Online Expertise: Demonstrated experience in designing, developing, and supporting SharePoint Online solutions in medium to large organisations. SharePoint Framework (SPFx): Advanced proficiency in SPFx, including modern web part development, extensions, and deployment. Power Platform: Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI integration to build business process automation and data visualisation solutions. Web Technologies: Expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and RESTful APIs. Cloud & Integration: Working knowledge of Azure services, Microsoft Graph, and third-party integrations. Migration Experience: Track record leading or supporting migrations from legacy SharePoint or other content management systems to SharePoint Online. Governance & Compliance: Familiarity with SharePoint governance, permissions, security, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, ISO, etc.). Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, present complex solutions, and deliver user training. Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities able to resolve issues quickly and efficiently. Project Management: Experience working in Agile or Waterfall project environments, collaborating within cross-functional teams. Additional Information: The candidate should have minimum 5 -7 years of experience in Microsoft 365 SharePoint Online Development. This position is based at our Kolkata office. A 15 years full time education is required.
